auth.label: API Token
auth.description: TikHub API token sent with the Authorization: Bearer header. Create it in the TikHub API key dashboard. Grant /api/v1/tikhub/user/ for validation and User actions. For invoke_endpoint, grant the requiredScope values returned by discover_endpoints for the functional endpoints you intend to call.

actions.name: discover_endpoints
actions.description: Discover current TikHub functional API endpoints from the official OpenAPI catalog, excluding account APIs.

query.description: Short title, operation ID, category, or path terms to match.

category.description: An exact TikHub functional API family name.

anyOf.description: An opaque cursor bound to the current catalog version and filters.

cursor.description: An opaque cursor bound to the current catalog version and filters.

limit.description: The maximum number of OpenAPI operations to inspect in this page.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for discovering current TikHub endpoints.

catalogVersion.description: The SHA-256 digest of the current TikHub OpenAPI catalog.

operationId.description: The OpenAPI operation identifier reported by TikHub.

title.description: The endpoint title from the TikHub OpenAPI catalog.

category.description: The TikHub API family from the OpenAPI catalog.

description.description: The current endpoint description from the TikHub OpenAPI catalog.

method.description: The HTTP method accepted by this endpoint.

path.description: The absolute TikHub API path or path template.

requiredScope.description: The TikHub token path scope required by this endpoint.

requestSchema.description: The dynamic path, query, and JSON body request schema.

items.description: One currently discovered TikHub endpoint contract.

endpoints.description: The endpoints discovered in this page.

nextCursor.description: The next opaque catalog cursor when more entries remain.

stale.description: Whether discovery used a recent stale catalog after a refresh failure.

outputSchema.description: The current page of TikHub functional endpoint contracts.

actions.name: invoke_endpoint
actions.description: Invoke one TikHub functional API endpoint at the fixed TikHub API origin. TikHub account endpoints are excluded.

method.description: The approved TikHub endpoint HTTP method.

path.description: The absolute TikHub API path or OpenAPI path template.
Path placeholder values keyed by placeholder name.

query.description: Query values keyed by the exact upstream parameter name.

body.description: The JSON request body for an approved POST endpoint, or null when absent.

request.description: The path, query, and optional JSON body sent to one TikHub endpoint.

inputSchema.description: A controlled dynamic TikHub endpoint invocation.

method.description: The HTTP method used for the TikHub request.

path.description: The final encoded TikHub API path used for the request.

anyOf.description: The TikHub request identifier when returned.

requestId.description: The TikHub request identifier when returned.

response.description: The complete successful TikHub JSON response body.
